classification_definitions.BASELINE_EXISTING: Repeatable failure also present on the clean exact parent.
classification_definitions.BRANCH_REGRESSION: Controlled branch failure absent on parent, supported by relevant branch difference; must fix before closure.
classification_definitions.ENVIRONMENTAL: Specific external configuration/resource cause demonstrated, rather than inferred from timing alone.
classification_definitions.NON_REPRODUCING_FLAKE: A prior failure did not recur in three exact-node reruns on either side; this is bounded non-reproduction, not proof that the test can never fail.
classification_definitions.REPRODUCIBLE_FLAKE: Both pass and fail outcomes observed in controlled exact-node reruns; parent evidence states whether it predates the branch.

full_suite_closure.merge_ready_scope: Local suite closure passed; PR #180 merge readiness is withheld until all required fresh GitHub checks pass after the CI dependency-contract fix. Does not authorize ML-B, production acceptance, or a merge.
